annotations.title: Request a time feel check (where does it drag?)

description: Request that real people experience a video, text, flow or waiting screen and report where it drags, when attention drops and how long it felt. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price on request – quoted individually. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.
